name: xemu
requirement: Original Xbox emulator. Library Play boots an Xbox disc image (XISO) with the owner's MCPX boot ROM, flash BIOS and hard disk image, placed from the BIOS inbox. Keyboard drives controller 1 (A B X Y keys, Enter, arrows; E S D F stick, W and O triggers). With a gamepad, assign it to port 1 in xemu's input settings.

firmware.name: mcpx_1.0.bin
firmware.note: MCPX boot ROM. Marquee's seeded xemu.toml points xemu at it.

firmware.name: Complex_4627.bin
firmware.note: Xbox flash ROM (1 MiB). Marquee's seeded xemu.toml points xemu at it.

firmware.name: xbox_hdd.qcow2
firmware.note: Xbox hard disk image. Marquee's seeded xemu.toml points xemu at it.

seed.contents:
[general]
show_welcome = false
skip_boot_anim = true

[general.updates]
check = false

[sys.files]
bootrom_path = '{xdg-data}/xemu/xemu/mcpx_1.0.bin'
flashrom_path = '{xdg-data}/xemu/xemu/Complex_4627.bin'
hdd_path = '{xdg-data}/xemu/xemu/xbox_hdd.qcow2'
eeprom_path = '{xdg-data}/xemu/xemu/eeprom.bin'
